decisions.name: DoesTheHolderNeedANumber
decisions.label: Does the Holder Need a Certification Number?

decisions.name: IsThereALicense
decisions.label: Is There a License to Print?

Flow.description: Records staff's decision on a individual application, from the Decide action. It first shows what stands in the way: required documents not yet accepted, fees not fully paid, and active stop codes on the holder. Approve is allowed only when the application is certified (entered through a form, on the portal or by staff), the documents are accepted and the fees paid. Approving a new application creates the license with License Number set to the holder's certification number, a dash and the license type's code (a person's first license gets a new certification number: the next Certification Number Counter value followed by their birth month and day, saved on the person), its expiration date from License Expiration Date; approving a renewal moves the existing license's expiration on and adds one to its renewal count; approving a duplicate records the date on the license as its Last Duplicate Date. from License Expiration Date; approving a renewal moves the existing license's expiration on and adds one to its renewal count; approving a duplicate records the date on the license as its Last Duplicate Date. Either way the license is marked ready to print (its Printed Date is cleared, so a license printed earlier goes back in the print queue) and the application is Approved with today as its Approved Date. A return records the reason and can create the return letter; an application can also be refused (Denied), with the reason saved and its unpaid fees set to Canceled.

formulas.name: forB_Ready
formulas.description: True when the application is certified, every required document is accepted and every fee is paid, so the application can be approved. The forms certify it, on the portal and in staff intake; an application made without a form is not certified.

formulas.name: forB_IsRenewal
formulas.description: True for a renewal of an existing license.

formulas.name: forB_IsDuplicate
formulas.description: True for a duplicate of an existing license: approving it records the date, which allows one duplicate per renewal period.

formulas.name: forB_IsNewLicense
formulas.description: True when approving creates a new license.

formulas.name: forT_LicenseTypeId
formulas.description: The license type whose expiration basis sets the new expiration date.

formulas.name: forD_StartDate
formulas.description: Where the new period starts: a renewal runs on from the current expiration date unless it has passed; a new license starts today.

formulas.name: forT_DurationType
formulas.description: The unit of the license type's term: days for licenses that run a set time from issue (the temporary permit), otherwise months.

formulas.name: forB_NeedsNumber
formulas.description: True when approving creates the person's first license, so they need a certification number.

formulas.name: forT_NewCertificationNumber
formulas.description: A new certification number: the next counter value followed by the holder's birth month and day (MMDD), as in the previous system.

formulas.name: forT_CertificationNumber
formulas.description: The holder's certification number, issued now if they have none. It is what prints on the license.

formulas.name: forT_NewLicenseNumber
formulas.description: The new license's License Number: the certification number, a dash and the license type's code (1536380804-C). License Number must be unique, and a person holds several licenses with the same certification number.

formulas.name: forB_BirthdayMissing
formulas.description: True when the holder has no date of birth but it is needed: the license expires on the birthday, or the holder needs a certification number, which ends in the birth month and day.

formulas.name: forN_BirthMonth
formulas.description: The holder's birth month, for licenses that expire on the birthday.

formulas.name: forN_BirthDay
formulas.description: The holder's birth day, for licenses that expire on the birthday.

formulas.name: forDT_PeriodEnd
formulas.description: The new expiration date at noon Louisiana time (the rule returns midnight GMT), so it shows as the same date in every US time zone.

formulas.name: forDT_PeriodStart
formulas.description: The period start at noon Louisiana time.

formulas.name: forN_RenewalCount
formulas.description: The license's renewal count after this renewal.

formulas.name: forT_LicenseName
formulas.description: The new license's name: the holder and the license type.

formulas.name: forT_LicenseId
formulas.description: The license the application is for: the one just created, or the existing one.

formulas.name: forT_ItemLine
formulas.description: One open checklist item for the summary.

formulas.name: forT_StopCodeLine
formulas.description: One active stop code for the summary.

formulas.name: forT_Summary
formulas.description: The review summary shown above the decision.
formulas.expression:
IF({!forB_Ready}, "

Ready to approve: the application is certified, every required document is accepted and the fees are paid.

", "

Not ready to approve.

") & IF({!GetApplication.IsCertified__c}, "", "

The application is not certified. It was not entered through an application form: enter it with New Application on the applicant's person account (for a business, the owner's or director's) so it is certified.

") & IF({!varN_OpenItems} > 0, "

Required documents not yet accepted:

    " & {!varT_OpenItemsText} & "
", "") & IF({!varN_UnpaidFees} + {!varN_UnpaidLicenseFees} > 0, "

Fees not fully paid: " & TEXT({!varN_UnpaidFees} + {!varN_UnpaidLicenseFees}) & IF({!varN_UnpaidLicenseFees} > 0, " (the renewal fee is on the license: see Fees and Payments on the person)", "") & "

", "") & IF({!varN_StopCodes} > 0, "

Active stop codes on the holder (the license will not print until they end):

    " & {!varT_StopCodesText} & "
", "")

Flow.label: Screen Flow: Individual Application Decide

recordUpdates.name: CancelUnpaidFees
recordUpdates.description: The application is denied, so its fees still Due or Partially Paid are canceled: they are no longer owed.
recordUpdates.label: Set Unpaid Fees to Canceled

fields.name: DA_Reason
fields.fieldText: What the applicant needs to know
fields.helpText: Saved as the Decision Reason. For a return, it is printed in the return letter.

fields.name: NB_Message
fields.fieldText: Nothing was saved. {!GetHolder.Name} has no date of birth on file, and it is needed for the license's expiration date or for the certification number, which ends in the birth month and day. Add it to their account, then run Decide again.

fields.name: AP_Message
fields.fieldText:
{!GetApplication.Name} is approved.

The license is marked ready to print. It prints once the holder has no active stop codes.

fields.name: ORL_Message
fields.fieldText: {!GetApplication.Name} is returned. The reason is saved on the application.

fields.name: RLS_Message
fields.fieldText: {!SaveReturnLetter.title} is in this application's Files. Open the letter to print it.

fields.name: RF_Message
fields.fieldText: {!GetApplication.Name} is denied. The reason is saved on the application, and its unpaid fees are canceled.

fields.name: NR_Message
fields.fieldText:
This application can't be approved yet. Approve is available only when the application is certified, every required document is accepted and the fees are paid.

{!forT_Summary}

fields.name: AD_Message
fields.fieldText: {!GetApplication.Name} is already {!GetApplication.Status}, so there is nothing to decide.

variables.name: recordId
variables.description: The application being decided. Named recordId because the quick action passes the record under that name.

variables.name: varN_OpenItems
variables.description: How many required checklist items are not yet accepted.

variables.name: varN_UnpaidFees
variables.description: How many of the application's fees are not fully paid.

variables.name: varN_UnpaidLicenseFees
variables.description: For a renewal, how many fees on the license being renewed are not fully paid. The renewal fee is raised on the license, not the application.

variables.name: varN_StopCodes
variables.description: How many stop codes are active on the holder.

variables.name: varDT_NewPeriodEnd
variables.description: The expiration date from License Expiration Date. The rule returns midnight GMT, so it is kept as a date and time and moved to noon Louisiana time.

variables.name: varT_OpenItemsText
variables.description: The open checklist items, one line each, for the summary.

variables.name: varT_StopCodesText
variables.description: The active stop codes, one line each, for the summary.
